description: Cold Movers is building a public web tool for SPHEREx: enter sky coordinates and watch the region change over time as a movie, so anyone can spot what moves or varies. Our Madhava engine fits a band-integrated Planck curve to the 102 infrared bands to estimate each object's temperature and flag unusual spectra. Led by a precision machinist and materials researcher from Honduras. We welcome help with web development, data visualization, astrophysics, and video.
